subject: Private visibility gateway verification & SIEM mapping
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@pioneerbank.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: claire.ng@pioneerbank.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Private deploy — visibility gateway verification request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this on. We need a short verification run of the visibility gateway for our private VPC deployment next week. Scope: logs (syslog, app JSON), metrics (Prometheus export), and tracing hooks (lightweight spans from transaction service).

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood run a 2-hour verification window where we push a controlled log/trace sample and confirm delivery into our Splunk instance + mapping spreadsheet?
- We need an itemized mapping (field -> Splunk index/event_type) to share with our security ops team.
- Confirm that gateway will not egress PII and that network flows only use the agreed egress IPs.

I attached a small sample bundle and our SIEM mapping template to speed this up. Proposed window: Thu 09/30, 11:00–13:00 PT.

Please loop in whichever internal folks you need — our SOC will be on standby.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Director, Platform Engineering
Pioneer Bank

Attachments: pioneer-siem-sample-logs.tar.gz, pioneer-siem-mapping.xlsx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@pioneerbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy — visibility gateway verification request

Thanks Samir — we can run the window on Thu 11:00–13:00 PT.

Plan (high level):
1) Pre-check (Thu 09:00–10:30): validate network routes, confirm egress IPs, and verify sample ingestion endpoints on Pioneer Splunk HEC.
2) Verification run (11:00–13:00): push sample logs/metrics/traces; monitor delivery and MTTD for any dropouts.
3) Post-run (13:15–14:00): produce a short mapping artifact and checklist noting any gaps.

Action items for internal folks:
- Marissa: create the mapping draft and run field-level redaction checks against the sample bundle.
- Kimberly: validate trace hooks and sampling configuration; we need span name conventions for Pioneer’s tracing console.
- Jonas: coordinate the gateway container image and ensure it is pinned to the private registry SHA.

Samir — can you confirm the HEC token we'll use is a test token and a reachable endpoint (give me URL + port)? Also confirm whether Pioneer wants raw JSON events or key/value pairs per the spreadsheet.

I attached a brief verification checklist (gateway-verify-checklist.md) that we’ll use as the runbook.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

Attachments: gateway-verify-checklist.md

Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 13:42:00 -0700

On Tue, Sep 28, 2027 at 10:05 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Plan (high level):
> 1) Pre-check...

Quick notes from the data/mapping side:
- I’ll populate pioneer-siem-mapping.xlsx with three sheets: logs, metrics, traces. Each row will call out: source field, redaction requirement, Redwood pipeline transform (if any), Splunk index & sourcetype.
- For logs: we should normalize timestamps to epoch_millis and include the original message as raw_event for auditability.
- For PII: I’ll run a tokenization pass and flag any fields matching the redaction list Samir provided last quarter. If anything is borderline we’ll surface it during the post-run report.

Attachment: initial_mapping_v1.xlsx (I will upload the final mapping to the shared Drive link before the run).

Marissa Cole
Principal Product Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rachel.kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, samir.rao@pioneerbank.com
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy — visibility gateway verification request

Folks — a couple technical clarifications before the run:

- Trace hooks: Redwood will emit lightweight spans with the following fields: span_name, span_id, trace_id, parent_id (optional), service.name, duration_ms, status_code, and user_agent (where available). We recommend sampling at 10% for the verification window to avoid ingest spikes; if Pioneer wants full traces on a tiny subset of endpoints we can toggle to 100% for those paths.

- Network/Egress: confirm the allowed egress CIDR list. Per policy we will only accept target HEC endpoints within that CIDR; anything outside will be blocked.

- Auth: we will not store HEC tokens in plaintext in the gateway image. Use an ephemerally provisioned secret via your KMS; send me the KMS key reference (ARN or vault path) and we’ll reference it in the container runtime only.

- Observability checks: during the pre-check I will run a sample trace and confirm the span propagation (we need to see trace_id across frontend -> transaction svc -> db proxy).

On the quoting front — Samir, please provide a test HEC endpoint and a short-lived token; Claire’s SOC can create a token scoped to the test index. If you can drop that into the Drive link I’ll pick it up.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@pioneerbank.com>
To: rachel.kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: claire.ng@pioneerbank.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy — visibility gateway verification request

Rachel / team — thanks for the plan and checklist. Confirming:
- Test HEC endpoint: https://splunk-ci.pioneerbank.internal:8088/services/collector (test index = rdw_test_index)
- Test token: will be created and pushed to the shared Drive as a text file by 09/30 09:30 PT (Claire will upload).
- Egress CIDRs: 10.45.200.0/24 and 10.45.201.0/24 — these are our approved inspection egresses.
- Pioneer wants JSON raw events for logs and Prometheus-style metrics (we can provide an export scraper). Traces as JSON OTLP-style spans.

We’ll have SOC (Claire) on-call during the window. Please run the pre-check at 09:00 PT and call us on Slack if you hit firewall issues.
